scope: W7: bare command resolution through PATH and PATHEXT

libraries.verified: 2026-11-07 W7: Windows drive-relative paths such as C:Projects are rooted but not fully qualified; Path.IsPathRooted therefore keeps them out of bare-name resolution. Context7 returned no precise PATHEXT rule, so the Microsoft Learn ProcessStartInfo and CreateProcessW vendor pages confirm PATH search and .exe-only suffix behavior (query: "C# .NET 10 ProcessStartInfo.FileName and UseShellExecute=false: does Process.Start resolve a bare command through PATHEXT when only a .cmd shim is on PATH? Explain ProcessStartInfo working directory vs search and CreateProcess resolution.").
